t: A desktop AI workspace for chatting with local or cloud models.
steps: Find the Msty Studio download on the Msty website.
Ask IT to approve the desktop install.
Install Studio on a teacher machine first.
Choose local models or connect a cloud provider key.
Check that the computer has enough RAM or GPU for a local model.
Read the privacy policy and keep telemetry off.
Test Knowledge Stacks on the free plan and note the limits.
